_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: Marcus 2026-09-21: L27 = L26 minus the three likelihood-flat fast-dynamics parameters (lambda/T_crit held at paleo medians, joint paleo draws attached in projection; gamma fixed) and the two ledger set-asides integrated out; 50 params. Hindcast unchanged vs L26 (every component <= 0.005 cm); BIC vs BRICK 2.0 positive at every rho bound (+21 at 0.99, dk 15); 8/50 marginals fail (AIS ridge only, Greenland converges). Between-refit precision measured: L27r/L27b reproduce every AIS projection median to <= 1.3 cm at 2300; the L26->L27 ocean-parameter shift was L26's own unfinished relaxation (CHANGELOG 09-21a). Paper's posterior since 09-20.
